- Category: Refactor / maintenance (auth/session handling)
- Scope: Small, focused change — 1 file, 12 lines touched (7 additions, 5 deletions) in src/auth/session.py
- Description states this cleans up session key rotation logic.
- Severity: Low-to-medium — touches authentication/session code, so it warrants a careful review of key rotation correctness, edge cases (e.g., concurrent rotation, expired keys, race conditions), and test coverage, even though the diff is small.
- Recommend: request unit tests covering rotation edge cases and confirm no behavior change for existing sessions before merge.
